QuestInfo.name: [Sizzling Santa] Rongo's Wrong-o
QuestInfo.0: Go speak to Rongo about what Louie mentioned.
QuestInfo.1: Bring the Explorer Book to Rongo to help build confidence.\r\n#bStay logged in for 180 minutes, and take the note to Rongo.#k

2.msg: I swear, I'm not doing that on purpose!

3.msg: N-no, I know... I didn't notice you.\r\nI was thinking about something.

5.msg: W-work? Oh, it's... it's... It's not going. At all.

7.msg: Well... I'm supposed to judge who gets gifts and who doesn't, right?

8.msg: It's just so hard for me to stamp that X next to someone's name, sealing their fate and denying them a gift! Sniff...

9.msg: Hey, don't cry. Let's take a look at the list together.\r\nShow me the one you're having trouble with.

10.msg: There are so many... Here, look at this one.

11.msg: Okay... Smartie from Edelstein.\r\nNaughty activity: Made fun of friend when friend made grammar mistake. Friend cried.

12.msg: But, I mean... the friend should have studied their grammar harder, right?\r\nSo maybe I should be giving this kid a gift? Since it was not 100% the kid's fault?

13.msg: Mm, no. If the friend was wrong, then the kids should have studied together instead of one picking on the other.

14.msg: Argh! You're right! I didn't even think about the friend's feelings.\r\nI am dumb! SO DUMB!

15.msg: No! No no no! Don't think that way. Calm down.

16.msg: Can we take a look at another kid? Here, this kid in Kerning City.\r\nI'm not sure about this one, too.

17.msg: Okay let's take a look. Ikarus in Kerning City.\r\nNaughty activity: Went into restricted area to find a way to fly.

18.msg: It's good to be curious, right?

19.msg: Yes, but it's bad to ignore rules like that.\r\nHe could have been hurt, or worse. That's what's important here.

20.msg: Argh! I knew it! I am useless!\r\nWho am I to judge these poor children?\r\nTo me... those kids are all angels.

21.msg: I think you can be more confident in yourself.\r\nYou have to believe that your decision is the right one.

23.msg: Of course. Making tough decisions is a part of any adventure.\r\nYou have to believe in yourself to even get into those situations.

24.msg: Well, if that's the case, can you show me how it's done?\r\nWhat kind of process you go through?

26.msg: You can help me, #h0#! I mean, I can't follow you around everywhere.\r\nIt's too scary and dangerous.

yes.0: But if you just keep track of everything you do, I can learn how to have the confidence of a powerful adventurer.

0.msg: Here is a logbook to help you. Good luck!

1.msg: Oh, thank you! This is so helpful...

default.0: I can learn how to have the confidence of a powerful adventurer.
